title: Close a harness task whose claim base the coordinator moved forward
goal: When origin/main moves during a mission, the native coordinator reconciles the worktree at its next commit and advances the claim's base, while the task record keeps the base it was claimed at. SusiTarget::close then refused its own accepted task with 'task is not owned by this native reservation', so any mission that overlapped a landing on main could not finish. Close accepts a record whose base is an ancestor of the claim's base; every other ownership check is unchanged.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-harness adapter.rs (close, claim, base_is_ancestor, the git runner), xtask local_workflow sync_commit.rs (reconcile_claimed_worktree_locked advances the claim base) and native_provenance.rs (task_for_claim does not bind the record to a base).
reuse.reason: One ancestry check through the adapter's existing git runner; nothing new is built.

results.change: SusiTarget::close accepts a task record whose base is an ancestor of the claim's current base (the coordinator advances the claim base when it reconciles a worktree with a newer main); every other ownership check is unchanged and the record is not rewritten. docs/harness-runbook.md lists what a fresh host needs and how a failed landing is finished.
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib the_precheck_closes_a_task_that_passes_on_the_untouched_base passed; with the ancestry check taken out the same test fails with 'task is not owned by this native reservation'.
results.live: Reproduced on mission claude-selfbuild-green (main moved 9ff087300 -> 69be24b64 mid-mission and close refused); after the fix the same retained candidate closed, and mission claude-selfbuild-3 closed a task across another move of main.
results.known_gap: A rerun of a mission cannot resume a candidate a failed landing retained (workflow start refuses the held claim); the runbook documents the operator path. Not built here: the harness crate and the repository test-line budget had no room for a tested resume path.
results.coordination: No claim could be published from this cloud session (HTTP 403 on refs/claims/* and refs/board/*); coordinated through this record and the commit trailers.
